properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 11 at 12:35PM EDT until August 12 at 4:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Morgan County in southeastern Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 400 AM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of the Muskingum River at and near
McConnelsville is expected this afternoon and evening.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1219 PM EDT, The gauge at McConnelsville on the Muskingum
River was reading 6.1 feet and rising. The river is forecast to
crest near 7.5 feet this evening. Due to the recent dam
replacement, the official flood stage is no longer representative
of known impacts. Flooding of areas away from the gauge can be
expected at lower stages. At stages of 7.5 feet, sections of
Route 669 above Malta and other roads along the river being to
flood. In addition, low-lying areas adjacent to the river,
including recreational boat ramps, will also experience flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
McConnelsville, Malta, Stockport and Eagleport.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 11 at 8:58AM EDT until August 11 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall
continues.

* WHERE...A portion of western Maryland, including the following
county, Garrett.

* WHEN...Until 200 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Roads remain closed due to flooding. Low-water crossings
are inundated with water and may not be passable. It will take
several hours for all the water from these storms to work
downstream.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 854 AM EDT, the Casselman River at Grantsville has crested
and is now receding, although flooding continues. Emergency
Management reports high water along the Cassleman River at
Durst Road, Jennings Road, Dung Hill Road, Bittinger Road,
and Maple Grove Road.
- Additional showers and thunderstorms may reach the area after
11 AM.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bittinger...                       Grantsville...
Friendsville...                    Accident...
Jennings...                        Keysers Ridge...
New Germany...                     Mineral Spring...
Merrill...                         Selbysport...
Piney Grove...
- Please visit www.weather.gov/safety/flood for flood safety
and preparedness information.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

In hilly terrain there are hundreds of low water crossings which are
potentially dangerous in heavy rain. Do not attempt to cross flooded
roads. Find an alternate route.
